Delhi Police Intensifies Crackdown on Wrong-Side Driving

Delhi Police have significantly increased enforcement against wrong-side driving, leading to a 98% rise in related challans. Over 2,000 First Information Reports (FIRs) have been filed in the past six months. This intensified crackdown follows discussions between the Lieutenant Governor and Delhi Police officials regarding the city's traffic situation.
